rss.title: 🔗 Copper Chain Net vs a Crystal Cone: 0 to 10 cm Off the Tip (wait for it)
rss.desc:
A copper chain net drops onto a crystal cone five times, each time a little further off the tip: 0, 2, 4.5, 5.5 and 10 cm. Dead centre it hugs. At 2 it still hugs. At 4.5 and 5.5 it lands lopsided, slips... and catches. And at 10 cm? Wait for the last one 😳 How far off before it slides?
🧪 100% 3D cloth simulation: every link is simulated, nothing scripted.
🎧 Soft chain-slide ASMR sounds, no music. Oddly satisfying to watch 😌

rss.desc:
🟢 One lime jelly ball, one glass funnel with a neck a quarter of the ball's width, five tries: 0%, 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% soft. The hard ball sits on top. Then it sinks to the neck, bulges, plugs it... and at 100%? Wait for the last one 😳 How soft to fit through?
🧪 100% 3D soft-body physics simulation: every wobble and squeeze comes from real physics, nothing scripted.
🎧 Soft, wet jelly ASMR sounds, no music. Oddly satisfying to watch 😌
